```{r}
df.prop.cancer.clusters <- t.cells@meta.data[t.cells$final.clones == "malig",]

df.prop.cancer.clusters <- df.prop.cancer.clusters %>%
  group_by(orig.ident, clusters.t.cells) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n))

df.prop.cancer.clusters <- df.prop.cancer.clusters[,c(1,2,4)] %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = orig.ident,
    values_from = proportion,
    values_fill = 0
  )
df.prop.cancer.clusters <- as.data.frame(df.prop.cancer.clusters)
#rownames(df.prop.cancer.clusters) <- paste0("Cluster_", df.prop.cancer.clusters$clusters.t.cells)

pheatmap(df.prop.cancer.clusters, show_colnames = F)

df.prop.cancer.clusters.ss <- df.prop.cancer.clusters[-9,]

pheatmap(df.prop.cancer.clusters, show_colnames = F)
pheatmap(df.prop.cancer.clusters.ss, show_colnames = F)
```

```{r}
#t.ss <- subset(t.cells, clusters.t.cells %in% c("6","2","4","5","8"))
df <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$final.clones))
df.query <- subset(df, malig > 20 & non_malig > 20)

t.ss <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident %in% rownames(df.query) & clusters.t.cells != "9")

split.t <- SplitObject(object = t.ss, split.by = "orig.ident")

markers.split.t <- lapply(names(split.t), FUN = function(sample_name) {
  # Get the current sample
  x <- split.t[[sample_name]]
  
  # Set identities to "final.clones"
  Idents(x) <- x$final.clones.norm.clusters
  
  # Extract only the "S1" column (assuming proportions are numeric)
  hc.clusters <- df.prop.cancer.clusters.ss[df.prop.cancer.clusters.ss[[sample_name]] > 0.1, , drop = FALSE]
  hc.clusters <- rownames(hc.clusters)
  
  # Filter hc.clusters to only those with ≥3 cells in this sample
  cluster_counts <- table(Idents(x))
  hc.clusters <- hc.clusters[hc.clusters %in% names(cluster_counts[cluster_counts >= 3])]

  # Skip if no valid clusters
  if (length(hc.clusters) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", sample_name, ": no valid clusters with ≥3 cells")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  print(sample_name)
  # Find markers for "malig" vs. other clones
  markers.x <- FindMarkers(
    x,
    ident.1 = "malig",
    ident.2 = hc.clusters) # Cluster of interest
  
  # Filter for significant markers (adjusted p-value < 0.05)
  #markers.x <- subset(markers.x, p_val_adj < 0.05)
  
  # Add the sample name to the results
  markers.x$sample <- sample_name
  
  markers.x$gene <- rownames(markers.x)
  
  # Return the significant markers with the sample name
  return(markers.x)
})

names(markers.split.t) <- names(split.t)

markers.split.t <- markers.split.t[-which(names(markers.split.t) == "S104")]

markers.split.t2 <- lapply(markers.split.t, FUN = function(x) {
  # Extract avg_log2FC and gene names
  res <- data.frame(
    gene = rownames(x),
    avg_log2FC = x$avg_log2FC,
    sample = x$sample
  )
  return(res)
})

# Combine all results into one data frame
combined_results <- do.call(rbind, markers.split.t2)

markers.matrix <- combined_results %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = avg_log2FC, values_fill = list(avg_log2FC = 0))

markers.matrix <- as.data.frame(markers.matrix)
rownames(markers.matrix) <- markers.matrix$gene
markers.matrix$gene <- NULL

totals <- as.data.frame(rowSums(markers.matrix))

pheatmap(markers.matrix, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)

zero_counts <- rowSums(markers.matrix == 0)
hist(zero_counts, breaks = 100)
markers.matrix.ss <- as.matrix(markers.matrix[zero_counts <= 60, ])
pheatmap(markers.matrix.ss)

column_sds <- apply(markers.matrix.ss, 2, sd)
samples_with_zero_sd <- names(column_sds[column_sds == 0])
markers.matrix.ss <- markers.matrix.ss[,!is.na(column_sds) & column_sds != 0]

markers.matrix.ss.scaled <- scale(markers.matrix.ss)
markers.matrix.ss.scaled[markers.matrix.ss.scaled > 3] <- 3
markers.matrix.ss.scaled[markers.matrix.ss.scaled < -3] <- -3
pheatmap(markers.matrix.ss.scaled)

df.sum <- data.frame(rowSums(markers.matrix.ss.scaled))
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
# 1. Create pseudobulk counts
pseudobulk <- AggregateExpression(
  t.ss,
  assays = "SCT",
  slot = "counts",
  group.by = c("orig.ident", "final.clones"),
  return.seurat = FALSE
)

nm <- grep("non-malig", colnames(pseudobulk$SCT))
mal <- setdiff(grep("malig", colnames(pseudobulk$SCT)), nm)
# 2. Extract counts for "malig" and "other" clones
malig_counts <- pseudobulk$SCT[, mal]
other_counts <- pseudobulk$SCT[, nm]

countdata <- as.matrix(cbind(malig_counts, other_counts))
which(is.infinite(countdata))
# 3. Create a DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = countdata,
  colData = data.frame(
    condition = c(rep("malig", ncol(malig_counts)), rep("nonmalig", ncol(malig_counts))),
    sample = rep(colnames(malig_counts), 2)
  ),
  design = ~ condition
)

# 4. Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)

res.df <- as.data.frame(res@listData)
rownames(res.df) <- res@rownames


res <- results(object = dds, contrast = c("condition", "malig", "nonmalig"))
res.table <- as.data.frame(res@listData)
rownames(res.table) <- res@rownames
res.table$gene <- rownames(res.table)

res.table <- res.table[order(-res.table$stat),]

vsdata <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
res.vst.table <- vsdata@assays@data@listData[[1]]

pca.out <- plotPCA(object = vsdata, ntop = 500, returnData = T)
plotPCA(object = vsdata, ntop = 500)

```


```{r}
vst.Counts <- res.vst.table
sigs <- subset(res.table, padj < 0.05)

sigs <- sigs[order(sigs$stat, decreasing = TRUE),]

tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJC]", rownames(merge), value = TRUE)
ig_genes <- grep("^IG[JHKL][VDJCMG]", rownames(merge), value = TRUE)


sigs.ss <- subset(sigs, gene %!in% c(tcr_genes, ig_genes))

keep <- c(head(rownames(sigs.ss), 50), tail(rownames(sigs.ss), 50))

mat <- vst.Counts[keep,]

pheatmap(mat, cluster_cols = F, scale = "row", cluster_rows = F)
```
